text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 5: Day-ahead forecasts against measured power in three weeks chosen by rule'
text.tspan: Figure 5: Day-ahead forecasts against measured power in three weeks

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is one plant, and each group of six rows is one week. Power is a share of capacity (vertical axis). Black: measured power. Blue: B0's forecast of that power. Orange: L1's forecast of that power. Each day is its own line, so no line runs across a night or a gap of more than 2 hours.'
text.tspan: Each row is one plant, and each group of six rows is one week. Power is a share of capacity (vertical axis). Black:
measured power. Blue: B0's forecast of that power. Orange: L1's forecast of that power.
Each day is its own line, so no line runs across a night or a gap of more than 2 hours.

g.aria-label: Symbol legend titled 'Series' for stroke color with 3 values: Measured, B0, L1

text.font-family: Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace
Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace
Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace

text.aria-label: Title text 'The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from one of three training runs (fitting seeds). Weeks are chosen by rule, not by eye, from the weeks in which every plant has at least 70% of the week's daylight hours scored: the sunniest (highest mean power across plants), the most variable between plants, and the cloudiest (lowest mean power). Arms. B0: the XGBoost baseline with no lagged power. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).'
